report.summary: Patient P-D007 (66F, Original Medicare with no transport benefit) needs transportation options. Her home tract (17031681000) is low-income with 45% no-vehicle households but has 44 nearby transit stops with early-morning service. Eligible resources: Kidney Care Rides (open to all) and Senior Shuttle West (free for age 60+, weekday medical appointments 7 AM–5 PM). Not eligible: Medicaid Ride Line (requires Medicaid). Paratransit is an option if she meets ADA criteria, but certification takes up to 21 days. Facility-based transit feasibility could not be checked because appointment location data is missing.

options.name: Kidney Care Rides
options.how_to_access: Contact Kidney Care Rides; open to everyone (eligibility marked likely_ok). Reference code ATK6D2F62.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM; patient age 66 is eligible. Call to schedule.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit)
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members; call number on card at least 2 business days ahead. Patient has Original Medicare, so not eligible.
